summary: Frontend-only regression testing on MobileCart rebrand (previously DEALKR). Verified all storefront + admin flows against the public preview URL. Core storefront pages, register/login, add-to-cart, wishlist, category browsing, full checkout with address+payment+order placement (order #MC-733949 confirmed), and admin dashboard/sections all work correctly with MobileCart branding. CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: /auctions page crashes with a React runtime error 'Cannot read properties of null (reading id)' making the entire auctions route unusable (bid button never rendered).

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime error 'Cannot read properties of null (reading id)' crashes the entire /auctions route. Root cause: `auctions.slice(1).map((entry) => <ProductCard product={entry.product} ... />)` passes `entry.product` even when it is null (refreshAuctions explicitly sets product to null when the backend response has no product). ProductCard then dereferences product.id and throws. Result: place-bid-button never renders, and the auction feature is completely broken.

action_items: FIX /auctions crash: In Auctions component (App.js ~line 466), filter out entries with null product before mapping to ProductCard, e.g. `auctions.slice(1).filter(e => e.product).map(...)`. Alternatively, guard ProductCard to early-return when product is null. Also consider the same fix around line 455 `auction.product?.name` (safe) but ensure header/product image also guards nulls.
Optional: Add a React error boundary around routed pages so a single bad entry does not blank out the whole page with the Emergent runtime overlay.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js ProductCard directly accesses product.id and product.image with no null guard; combined with refreshAuctions() setting product=null when missing, this is a guaranteed crash for any auction whose product is unresolved.

Login page uses HTML5 required + type=email; when a user enters an invalid email domain (e.g. .test TLD), backend returns 422 but UI stays on /login without visible toast in some cases. Consider surfacing 422 detail messages explicitly.

Detail page uses data-testid `detail-add-to-cart` / `detail-buy-now` while grid cards use `add-product-<id>` / `hot-add-<id>`. Inconsistent naming; consider unifying to `add-product-*` everywhere for easier automation.
Auctions grid does not paginate or handle empty state cleanly; when only one auction exists, the 'More Live Auctions' section still renders an empty grid heading.

FAILING: /auctions page throws React runtime error and does not render bid button. Retest bidding after main agent adds a null-product guard in Auctions grid.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: navigate to https://dashboard-design-20.preview.emergentagent.com/auctions. Observed: Emergent 'Runtime error' overlay with 'Cannot read properties of null (reading id)' at bundle.js:1000. Console also logs 'An error occurred in the <ProductCard> component'. Root cause in /app/frontend/src/App.js line 466: `{auctions.slice(1).map((entry) => <ProductCard product={entry.product} ... />)}`. refreshAuctions (line 579) intentionally maps entries to product:null when the backend does not include a product, and ProductCard (line 113+) reads product.id and product.image unconditionally. Mitigation: filter null products before mapping (or return null from ProductCard when product is falsy).
